publication_status: Published profile — taxonomy notes independently maintained
taxonomy_summary: Crossotarsus emancipatus Murayama, 1934. Original description and historical taxonomic treatments are displayed with claim-specific source verification; provisional distribution and host assertions remain separate from nomenclatural decisions.
nomenclature_note: The original description includes a correction of a historical Crossotarsus terminatus identification. That determination error is not evidence of synonymy between C. terminatus and C. emancipatus.

resources.images: No image with confirmed public reuse rights is linked in this release.
resources.specimens: Specimen/type evidence is recorded in the cited original descriptions; specimen accessions have not been independently mapped to online repositories.

provenance.scope: Distribution and host entries are consolidated and accepted for website presentation; specific unresolved nomenclatural and biological qualifications remain separately annotated.
